be-dockerfile.code:
# Build stage
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build

WORKDIR /src

# Copy project files
COPY ARMS.sln ./
COPY ARMS.API/ARMS.API.csproj ARMS.API/
COPY ARMS.Application/ARMS.Application.csproj ARMS.Application/
COPY ARMS.Domain/ARMS.Domain.csproj ARMS.Domain/
COPY ARMS.Infrastructure/ARMS.Infrastructure.csproj ARMS.Infrastructure/

# Restore dependencies
RUN dotnet restore ARMS.API/ARMS.API.csproj

# Copy source code
COPY . .

# Build
RUN dotnet build ARMS.API/ARMS.API.csproj \
    -c Release \
    --no-restore

# Publish
RUN dotnet publish ARMS.API/ARMS.API.csproj \
    -c Release \
    -o /app/publish \
    --no-restore


# Runtime stage
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS final

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=build /app/publish .

ENV ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://+:5000

EXPOSE 5000

ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "ARMS.API.dll"]

name: CI

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4

      - run: dotnet restore
      - run: dotnet build --no-restore
      - run: dotnet test --no-build --verbosity normal

be-branch-rules.code:
BASE="${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}"
          HEAD="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}"
          
          # PR targeting main: source must be dev or development
          if [[ "$BASE" == "main" || "$BASE" == "master" ]]; then
            if [[ "$HEAD" != "dev" && "$HEAD" != "development" ]]; then
              echo "::error::PRs to main can only come from dev or development. Current source: $HEAD"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          
          # PR targeting dev/development: source must NOT be main
          if [[ "$BASE" == "dev" || "$BASE" == "development" ]]; then
            if [[ "$HEAD" == "main" || "$HEAD" == "master" ]]; then
              echo "::error::PRs to dev/development cannot come from main. Use a feature branch."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

fe-render.code:
# Render deployment for the ARMS frontend (Vite static site).
#
# The app uses BrowserRouter, so paths like /student/dashboard exist only
# client-side. Without the rewrite below, refreshing any page other than /
# makes Render look for that file and return "Not Found". The rewrite serves
# index.html for every path and React Router takes over from there.
#
# Equivalent dashboard setting (Static Site > Redirects/Rewrites):
#   Source: /*    Destination: /index.html    Action: Rewrite
services:
  - type: web
    runtime: static
    name: arms-frontend
    buildCommand: npm ci && npm run build
    staticPublishPath: ./dist
    routes:
      - type: rewrite
        source: /*
        destination: /index.html

const isActivePath = (activePath, href) =>
  activePath === href || activePath.startsWith(`${href}/`)

// The most specific link that matches the page, so a parent link (e.g. /venues) doesn't stay
// highlighted on its child pages (/venues/access) that have their own link.
const findActiveHref = (sections, activePath) =>
  sections
    .flatMap((section) => section.items.map((item) => item.href))
    .filter((href) => href && isActivePath(activePath, href))
    .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0]
